newsitem.title: JAPAN: Matsushita, ITJ to join in int'l telecom service.
newsitem.headline: Matsushita, ITJ to join in int'l telecom service.

text.p: Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd and International Telecom Japan Inc (ITJ) will jointly launch an international telecommunications service as early as the end of this year, a Japanese daily and Kyodo news service reported on Sunday.
The new venture aims to provide small businesses with international communication services at lower rates than those of its competitors, Kyodo said.
The Daily Yomiuri said a partnership with ITJ will enable Matsushita, which currently offers a domestic long-distance service, to enter the international market.

ITJ can increase users through this partnership by sharing a long-distance circuit with Matsushita and adding connection points which would enable it to offer less-expensive services to corporations, the newspaper said.
The joint venture plans to attract 100 corporate users by 1997 with its lower rates, Kyodo and Yomiuri said.
Joint businesses by telecom companies are expected to accelerate competition in both domestic and international markets, Yomiuri said.
